layout: app/modules/info_donation/ — 2 registered function groups (info_donation_donate, info_donation_review). Page surface: /help-the-next-tenant (shell--solo).

input_audit.note: Per-item opt-in answers from the donation page form (selects, checkboxes, textareas), validated against catalog.py.
Sent by the consent button; must equal catalog.CONSENT_VERSION — proves the tenant saw the current consent text.
Donation row id for withdraw/review actions.

preview_state: review-before-submit — the page renders the exact answers to be stored before POST /donate
review_state: free-text items stored as moderation=pending; never served until approved by a reviewer
output_how: Writes info_donation_items rows (aggregate-only donation answers) and info_donation_profiles rows (resolution gate, consent, dismissal state).
output_why: Serves the Info Donation functions declared in its FunctionGroupContracts.
process_description: CANONICAL post-resolution info donation. Resolved-gate + versioned informed consent + per-item opt-in + PII-screened free text held in moderation + per-item and withdraw-all revocation. Server-side aggregate storage by explicit consent only — the zero-persistence promise still applies to documents.
process_context: Tenant-facing T2 module. Invoked via /help-the-next-tenant and /api/info-donation/* routes. Resolution arrives via POST /resolved or EventType.ISSUE_RESOLVED from any module.
